SELECT A.CITY_SRNO, A.CITY_PORT_DSCD, N.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM, A.ENG_CITY_NM, A.NACD, B.ENG_NL_NM, A.ENG_CITY_RGN_NM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM FROM CSPD118TI A , CSPD115TI B , CSPD112TI N WHERE A.NACD = B.NACD (+) AND B.RPRS_CD_YN = 'Y' AND N.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '905' AND A.CITY_PORT_DSCD = N.AI_INPT_CMN_CD
ORDER BY A.NACD
ORDER BY A.NACD DESC
ORDER BY B.ENG_NL_NM
ORDER BY B.ENG_NL_NM DESC
ORDER BY N.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM
ORDER BY N.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.ENG_CITY_NM
ORDER BY A.ENG_CITY_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.ENG_CITY_RGN_NM
ORDER BY A.ENG_CITY_RGN_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.CITY_PORT_DSCD, A.ENG_CITY_RGN_NM

/* 부재관리 (7070) */ /* AdminCityMapper.selectListTotCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CSPD118TI A , CSPD115TI B , CSPD112TI N WHERE A.NACD = B.NACD AND B.RPRS_CD_YN = 'Y' AND N.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '905' AND A.CITY_PORT_DSCD = N.AI_INPT_CMN_CD
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CSPD118TI A USING DUAL ON (A.CITY_SRNO = #{citySrno}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.CITY_PORT_DSCD = UPPER(#{cityPortDscd}), A.LST_DB_CHG_ID = #{lstDbChgId}, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM = , A.ENG_CITY_NM = UPPER(#{engCityNm}), A.ENG_CITY_RGN_NM = UPPER(#{engCityRgnNm}), A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno}, A.NACD = UPPER(#{nacd}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( A.CITY_SRNO, A.CITY_PORT_DSCD, A.ENG_CITY_NM, A.NACD, A.ENG_CITY_RGN_NM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM )VALUES( (SELECT MAX(CITY_SRNO) FROM CSPD118TI)+1 , UPPER(#{cityPortDscd}) , UPPER(#{engCityNm}) , UPPER(#{nacd}) , UPPER(#{engCityRgnNm}) , #{trnLogSrno} , #{lstDbChgId} , )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CSPD118TI WHERE CITY_SRNO = UPPER(#{citySrno})
